title: Goblin Diplomacy
start: Go to the Goblin Village and talk to General Bentnoze or General Wartface.

items.t: 3 suits of goblin mail (can be obtained during quest)
Blue dye (or 2 woad leaves and 5 coins to obtain from Aggie or Rana the dyer)
Red dye (or 3 redberries and 5 coins to obtain from Aggie or Rana the dyer)
Yellow dye (or 2 onions and 5 coins to obtain from Aggie or Rana the dyer)
OR instead of red dye and yellow dye
Orange dye (or mix red dye and yellow dye)

recommended.t: Archaeology teleport to teleport to General Bentnoze and General Wartface

steps.t: Teleport to Falador and run north along the road to the Goblin Village.

Talk to General Bentnoze or General Wartface, both of whom are located in the hut. [Chat: 1 So how is life for the goblins? › 2 Do you want me to pick an armour colour for you? › 3 What about a different colour? › Accept]
If you need goblin mail, you can grab three suits of goblin mail from the following crates:

sub.t: Up a ladder in the middle of the gate entrance of the camp.

steps.t: Dye one goblin mail blue and another orange.
Use the orange goblin mail on one of the generals.
After the cutscene, use the blue goblin mail on one of them.
Use a normal goblin mail on one of them.
